description: This file defines an enum class ShareProductDividendStatusType representing dividend status types for share products in the Fineract system. It includes status constants with associated integer codes and string identifiers, methods for converting from integers, getting properties, and checking approval status.

classes.name: ShareProductDividendStatusType
classes.description: Enumeration of share dividend status types with associated integer codes and string identifiers, along with utility methods.

methods.name: ShareProductDividendStatusType
methods.description: Constructor initializing the enum with a specific integer value and code string.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer to a corresponding ShareProductDividendStatusType enum value; defaults to INVALID if no match.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer code associated with the status.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the status.

methods.name: isApproved
methods.description: Checks whether the current status is the 'APPROVED' status.
